thread:
maya: Heads-up — PR #85731 is ready for review when folks have a sec. Adds an async KV prefetch fallback to reduce cold-start token spikes. Main risks: (1) runtime correctness around concurrent KV writes, (2) KMS usage spike on first rollout, (3) extra metrics emitted. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/85731 :link:
jamie: @maya thanks — can you paste the short perf numbers here? quick check pls :eyes:
alex: I can take runtime review, ping me for pairing. I skimmed the diff and main loop looks fine but want to run integration tests locally.
maya: perf — dev run on p4: median latency down ~12% for 1–4 token bursts, p99 roughly unchanged. Cost added ~1% due to extra prefetch ops but expected to pay off for bursty workloads.
sam: I can look at infra/KMS impact. Do you have an expected QPS for the prefetch init ops?
taylor: fyi rotation window for KMS keys is tomorrow morning; if this spikes usage we might want to hold until rotation completes.
maya: expected QPS for prefetch init is low — only on cache miss paths. rough estimate ~0.5–1% of existing read QPS for canary traffic. Still want infra sign-off though.
jamie: runtime notes — small nits inline, but two things to call out: concurrent write on line 248 needs a lock or CAS; also the fallback path doesn't propagate trace id in one branch (we lose trace for that path).
alex: i'll pair with @jamie tomorrow morning to hammer the concurrent write and add trace propagation. should be a quick follow-up.
sec-bot: Automated security scan: no high severity findings; flagged a missing KMS access audit log statement in one code path. See CI artifact: https://ci.redwood-inference/85731/security-scan
maya: thanks @sec-bot — I'll add the audit log in the same follow-up patch.
sam: infra acceptance: i ran a smoke deploy in staging, KMS rate looked fine. one suggestion: add a circuit-breaker metric so operators can quickly disable prefetch if we see unexpected cost.
taylor: +1 on circuit-breaker; also keep an eye on key rotation tomorrow. If we ship before rotation I want a rollback plan.
maya: plan — merge to canary after runtime + infra + security quick sign-offs. alex & jamie to push runtime fix by EOD, i'll add audit log + circuit-breaker toggle. canary target: tomorrow 10:00 PST. rollback: revert canary flag, and pin to previous model routing.
jamie: noted. tagging @deploy-bot to schedule canary at that time.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2024-03-19T18:00:00Z (canary window ID: cw-4123). Please ensure follow-up PRs are merged before schedule. :robot_face:
maya: ok, thanks everyone. If no objections by EOD I'll mark PR ready-to-merge and we can proceed with the canary plan. :thumbsup:
